doc.title: Jack Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997

title: Opening and introduction at Hamilton College
summary: Monk Rowe introduces Palmer and they chat about the Swing Era and other interviewees.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we’re filming today at Hamilton College for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. I’m very happy to have my personal friend and veteran musician Jack Palmer from Rome, New York. Welcome to Hamilton.
Oh, thank you very much for the nice introduction.
Well I practiced a lot on that one, because I’ve been looking forward to this time when we could do this.
And it was interesting that you were just looking at the other folks we’ve interviewed and a lot of them were your personal friends.
Oh, yeah. Yes I was surprised at all you had there.
The Swing Era of music was quite a time for music in the United States.
Oh, dear, yeah. A great era. A beautiful era.
